roles.name: Villager
roles.description: No special ability. Find the werewolves and vote them out.

roles.name: Werewolf
roles.description: Each night the werewolves agree on one player to eliminate. Hide your identity by day.

roles.name: Seer
roles.description: Each night you may learn whether one player is a werewolf.

roles.name: Doctor
roles.description: Each night you may protect one player from elimination.

roles.name: Witch
roles.description: You have one potion that saves a player and one that eliminates a player. Each can be used once.

roles.name: Hunter
roles.description: When you are eliminated, you may take one player down with you.
